chapter: Lecture 5: Weathering of Rocks and Minerals — Types, Physical & Biological Agents
subject: agricultural_chemistry_and_soil_science

questions.stem: Why does coarse-textured porous Sandstone weather more rapidly than dense, crystalline Basalt?

options.A: Sandstone contains higher concentrations of ferromagnesian olivine.
options.B: The high permeability of porous sandstone allows deep water and air circulation into its internal pore network.
options.C: Sandstone reflects 100% of incident solar radiation.
options.D: Basalt dissolves instantly in pure rainwater.

questions.correct_answer: B) The high permeability of porous sandstone allows deep water and air circulation into its internal pore network.
questions.rationale: Rock permeability is the primary determinant of weathering rate; porous sandstone permits rapid fluid ingress whereas dense basalt restricts flow. (Key Takeaway: Permeability controls weathering velocity by governing internal fluid circulation.)

questions.stem: Under diurnal temperature fluctuations, how does the cubical thermal expansion of Quartz compare to that of Feldspar minerals?

options.A: Quartz cubical expansion is half that of feldspar.
options.B: Quartz cubical expansion is precisely twice (2.0x) that of feldspar.
options.C: Quartz expands linearly while feldspar does not expand.
options.D: Quartz and feldspar possess identical thermal expansion coefficients.

questions.correct_answer: B) Quartz cubical expansion is precisely twice (2.0x) that of feldspar.
questions.rationale: The cubical thermal expansion of quartz is twice that of feldspars, generating intergranular micro-shear stresses during solar heating. (Key Takeaway: Quartz expands cubically at twice the rate of feldspar.)

questions.stem: What bursting pressure is exerted by freezing water when confined within rigid rock fissures in alpine regions?
questions.rationale: Freezing water in confined crevices expands by 9% and exerts a bursting pressure of 1465 Mg m⁻² (1465 tonnes/m² / ~14.4 MPa). (Key Takeaway: Confined frost wedging generates 1465 Mg m⁻² of bursting pressure.)

questions.stem: According to the eolian transport power law, how does the particle-carrying capacity of wind scale with its velocity (v)?

options.C: Proportional to the sixth power of velocity (v⁶)

questions.correct_answer: C) Proportional to the sixth power of velocity (v⁶)
questions.rationale: The sediment-carrying capacity of wind increases exponentially, proportional to the sixth power of its velocity (v⁶ law). (Key Takeaway: Wind sediment carrying capacity scales with the sixth power of velocity.)

questions.stem: Why is mechanical rock disintegration significantly greater near a river's source than near its mouth?

options.A: Water near the mouth is completely frozen year-round.
options.B: River headwaters have steep gradients, high kinetic velocities, and carry coarse angular bedload that collides forcefully with bedrock.
options.C: Rivers near their source contain high concentrations of synthetic industrial acids.
options.D: River mouths experience higher diurnal solar radiation.

questions.correct_answer: B) River headwaters have steep gradients, high kinetic velocities, and carry coarse angular bedload that collides forcefully with bedrock.
questions.rationale: Steep mountain headwaters provide high kinetic energy and angular suspended matter that maximize hydraulic rock abrasion. (Key Takeaway: High velocity and angular bedload make river sources zones of intense disintegration.)

questions.stem: What is the linear thermal expansion relationship between massive Granite and porous Sandstone under heating?

options.A: Granite linear expansion is twice that of sandstone.
options.B: Granite linear expansion is half (0.5x) that of sandstone.
options.C: Granite linear expansion is equal to sandstone.
options.D: Granite does not exhibit linear thermal expansion.

questions.correct_answer: B) Granite linear expansion is half (0.5x) that of sandstone.
questions.rationale: The linear thermal expansion of granite is half that of sandstone under equivalent thermal cycling. (Key Takeaway: Granite linear expansion is half that of sandstone.)

questions.stem: What stream velocity is required for flowing water to transport heavy stones and pebbles?
questions.rationale: A current velocity of 1.2 m/s provides sufficient kinetic energy to transport stones and pebbles. (Key Takeaway: Fluvial currents at 1.2 m/s transport heavy stones.)

questions.stem: How do deep tap roots facilitate sub-surface chemical and physical weathering after plant death?

options.A: They solidify into impermeable granite plugs.
options.B: They decompose to leave open cylindrical macropores that funnel gravitational water and atmospheric gases deep into bedrock.
options.C: They absorb all sub-surface oxygen, preventing chemical reactions.
options.D: They compress bedrock into metamorphic quartzite.

questions.correct_answer: B) They decompose to leave open cylindrical macropores that funnel gravitational water and atmospheric gases deep into bedrock.
questions.rationale: Decayed tap roots leave macropore channels that enable deep percolation of rainwater and air into sub-regolith rock strata. (Key Takeaway: Decayed root macropores channel water and air deep into subsoil rock layers.)

questions.stem: What ecological phenomenon describes the biological mixing and vertical mass transport of soil and mineral particles by subterranean organisms?
questions.rationale: Pedoturbation is the biological turning, churning, and vertical transport of soil and weathered mineral fragments by ants, termites, and burrowers. (Key Takeaway: Pedoturbation is the biological mass transport and mixing of soil horizons.)

questions.stem: Why does physical fragmentation of a rock mass accelerate subsequent chemical mineral decomposition?

options.A: It converts all silicate minerals into pure quartz.
options.B: It exponentially increases the total exposed specific surface area, providing abundant reactive atomic sites for aqueous chemical attack.
options.C: It raises the rock's temperature to magmatic melting points.
options.D: It eliminates all moisture from the rock interior.

questions.correct_answer: B) It exponentially increases the total exposed specific surface area, providing abundant reactive atomic sites for aqueous chemical attack.
questions.rationale: Chemical reactions occur at particle surfaces; physical fragmentation increases specific surface area exponentially, accelerating dissolution kinetics. (Key Takeaway: Physical fragmentation expands reactive surface area for chemical attack.)
